name: Batfolk
description: Bloomburrow animalfolk known for clerics and astronomers who read the stars; protective, hierarchical guardians of the Valley's night.

timeline.summary: Batfolk across the Valley host the Lunar Paean at the end of each moon phase, assigning star charts to newborns and stars to the deceased.
timeline.quote: At the end of each of the four moon phases, batfolk across Valley host a celebration known as a Lunar Paean.

citation.text: "Bat", section "Bloomburrow". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: An elder batfolk at the Lighttrap Spires trades their sight for vision of the realms beyond, marking their ascension to the priesthood's upper ranks.
timeline.quote: There, an elder batfolk trades their sight for vision of the realms beyond Valley.

citation.text: "Bat", section "Bloomburrow". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
